title: PairRecoverStartResponse
description: Response to POST /api/v1/pair/recover/start containing a receiver-issued single-use challenge nonce.

challenge_nonce.description: Random single-use nonce in base64url (at least 16 bytes, 22 chars), issued by receiver

server_michi_id.description: Server identity derived as base64url(BLAKE3(public_key)), exactly 43 chars, no padding

server_public_key.description: Server Ed25519 public key in base64url, exactly 43 chars, no padding
